welcome.title: Welcome to Guardian Connector!
welcome.body: Let's take a tour of how you can use the tools.
welcome.exit: Feel free to exit this tour at any time — you can always bring it back using the {icon} icon on the top right of the menu.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.body: Open maps, alerts dashboards, and media galleries for your community data.

superset.title: Superset
superset.body: Build charts, analyses, and dashboards from your data.

filebrowser.title: Filebrowser
filebrowser.body: Browse, upload, and share files and raw data securely.

windmill.title: Windmill
windmill.body: Upload data, schedule data downloads, and automate workflows.

customApp.title: Custom apps
customApp.body: Open community apps hosted on your Guardian Connector instance.

dataSources.title: There's more below
dataSources.body: Scroll down to learn about a selection of the data collection tools that feed into Guardian Connector, like CoMapeo, KoboToolbox, and ODK.

docs.title: Need help?
docs.body: If you need any help, please see our documentation.

display.title: Light and dark mode
display.body: Switch the display between light and dark to match your preference.

language.title: Language
language.body: Change the language used across this Guardian Connector instance.

adminApps.title: Add custom apps
adminApps.body: Add cards for apps hosted on your instance so members can open them from this page.

adminTheme.title: Set your branding
adminTheme.body: Choose the logo and background image for your instance.

adminUsers.title: Manage users
adminUsers.body: Approve new accounts and assign the roles that control what each person can see.
